items.html: And we will begin to explain the ten Sefirot of the Nukva of ZA, in the aspect of the four worlds ABYA. Know that the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut has in her ten Sefirot, and in every Sefira there are three levels — the inner (Panim), the posterior (Achor), and the middle (Emtza'i) — and all these are the aspect of the body of the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut: for they are ten within ten, and another ten within them, being three garments (Levushim), each one comprised of ten. And these three levels that we have mentioned are the thirty names that the Nukva of ZA has, which are her body, as will be stated, with God's help. And these three aforementioned levels are clothed in BYA. (And the matter is the diminution of the moon.)
